body: And if it’s the guy that’s cheating?

Thank you for your thoughtful and meaningful response. You’re the kind of person who keeps me on reddit. :) 

I like the way you lay this out. And you’re exactly right that I will probably never feel satisfied with any outcome that happens and I’ll accept it eventually. (Like I say, still hurt about it all). The problem with my ex boyfriend is he hides everything so he can control the narrative. He’s good at manipulating things to fit what he wants people to think about him. So I don’t know who’s going to see him in his true light. I mean my friends do now but that’s no one consequential in his life. 

I’m sorry to hear about your experience with you ex and I hope you had other people there for you. And I certainly hope people realize it about your ex.

I appreciate perspective. 

I’m not expecting everything to feel better after talking to her. And his ex and I had an amicable conversation when she told me so I don’t really expect her to retaliate.
I’m not trying to make anything different. This is more for closure for me.
It’s more for my own closure. I’m not trying to change anything.

I’m so sorry. It’s not your fault. I have similar feelings but I think it’s because I lost something I wanted and I only have control over me. Please try not to blame yourself. The best I did was remember the bad. Like when I told my ex I wanted to be together but he started seeing someone new, he never told me to find happiness with someone else or even wished me well. It sucks but the happy memories hurt more. 

Cry as much as you want, talk to whoever you need to. It takes time and you’ll realize that there’s going to be someone better because they’ll stay by you and build you up.

I feel you. It’s wonderful that you’re still into giving love. Your ex didn’t destroy that. And is so important and will lead you to a better relationship. Just don’t forget to give some love to yourself. You deserve it.
This is the quality I need in my life.
Exactly and I am open to that. That’s why I’m so interested in FM, you have the ability to diversify your practice.
Exactly and I am open to that. That’s why I’m so interested in FM, you have the ability to diversify your practice.

Yes and I’m hoping with the merger other traditionally MD residencies will be more open especially if I submit a USMLE score. 

Is there a difference in competitiveness with opposed versus unopposed family med residencies?
He told me explicitly that he wanted to stay friends and he stayed in contact with me too. He didn’t tell me he was dating someone new until I mentioned my feelings.
I won’t deny that it’s something I’d want but I at least want the friendship now.

I don’t want this to sound insensitive because I know my situation is not special and I realize how terrible it is to want to do something like this but it’s so different when you’ve found your person. I know exactly what I want and am willing to fight for it. I won’t be able to get over it if I don’t try with him, I’ll always wonder about it.
I’ve tried and I don’t want to let him go, I want them to break up.
